purpose: Teach: 些細/年中/最期/人前/一夜/ほしく/濃く/くさい

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: クラスメイト、些細なことで、揉めてた。
lines.en: Some classmates were arguing over something really petty.
lines.style: Casual observation, slight eyeroll underneath. Even pace, matter-of-fact. Like she's seen this a hundred times before.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: うん。年中、課題、出されまくり。
lines.en: Yeah. They pile assignments on us constantly.
lines.style: Dry agreement, almost sympathetic. Understated. Light shrug in the voice—commiseration without drama.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 物語の主人公、最期のシーン、感動した。
lines.en: The main character's final scene really got to me though.
lines.style: Genuine warmth breaking through. Slight energy shift—leaning forward. Real, not performed. A moment of honest feeling.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 部活、人前でフリースタイル、恥ずかしいよな。
lines.en: Doing freestyle dancing in front of everyone at club would be so mortifying.
lines.style: Rueful, slightly pained laugh under the surface. Slower on the key words. The particular anxiety of being watched doing something difficult.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 一夜で覚えるテスト勉強、限界ある。
lines.en: Cramming all night before a test only goes so far.
lines.style: Quiet realism, a little defeated. Steady, thoughtful pace. The voice of someone who's tried and knows the ceiling.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 新作ゲーム、買ってほしくなった。
lines.en: That new game came out—I really want it.
lines.style: Sudden brightness, almost eager. Quick attack on the opening. Unguarded for a moment—the real want slipping through.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 抹茶、濃く点てるの、難しい。
lines.en: Getting matcha to the right thickness when you whisk it is harder than it looks.
lines.style: Thoughtful, slightly self-critical. Slow on the technique words. The voice of someone paying attention to something small and finding it actually matters.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 体育館、汗のにおいで、ちょっとくさいかも。
lines.en: The gym kind of reeks with all that sweat, honestly.
lines.style: Wry, slightly disgusted, light and quick. A small laugh in there somewhere. Casual observation delivered like a joke only they would get.
